'''Wolf Diamond-Innes''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2000 Utica tournament]] on 1 March 2000 with Cloud City deck, according to Clint Prong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d298">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-02-wizards-of-the-coast-utica-mi-3-1-2000d298/ wizards-of-the-coast-utica-mi-3-1-2000], DeckTech (Clint "Gold93" Prong, 2 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-02-wizards-of-the-coast-utica-mi-3-1-2000d298/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
